 * fidelity fields an ai-sdk turn may carry — `usage` (the turn's observed

evidence.reason: The comment at src/harness/session.ts:65-72 says old readers reject only the new optional `usage`/`toolCalls` keys, which is misleading for rollback: the same format also includes new `tool-failure` and `budget-stop` line types (lines 30-31), and the load contract rejects malformed/unknown complete lines with a corrupt-line error. An older reader encountering either new line type would reject the whole session, not just the optional message keys. This is a documentation-accuracy defect rather than a new requirement or protection scope.
